name: SH2 Cast - Left Staff (self)
description: MSCO's Base - Left Staff MSCO_left5.hkx on all four neutral MSCO_left1-4 path names, for a fire-and-forget SELF cast resolved to the LEFT hand while a staff is held in that hand (owner ruling 2026-08-29: clip 5 is the self-delivery staff art). Above cast_left_self and cast_left_staff, so a staff self cast reaches its own cell rather than either neighbour. One clip fills four slots, so the stamps are per-file (ADR-0017). The clip carries MSCO's MLh_SpellFire_Event at 0.500000 and the same window quartet the other self cells carry.
